The Sunday letter

The art of paying attention.

This morning, I noticed a tiny plant growing between two stones on the way to the bakery. It has probably been there for weeks. Today was the first time I looked.

We have a habit of saving our attention for remarkable things. A new city. A big decision. A beginning. But ordinary days are full of beginnings, if we give them a little room.

Here is a small experiment for the week: choose one familiar place, and find something you have never noticed before. No photograph required. Just a moment that belongs to you.

See you next Sunday,
Ellis
